CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: O Jehovah, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
Be merciful to me, Jehovah, for I am faint. O Jehovah, heal me, for my bones are in agony.
I am in anguish. How long, O Jehovah, how long?
Return, O Jehovah, and deliver me. Save me because of your unfailing love.
No one remembers you when he is dead. Who praises you from the grave?
I am worn out from groaning. All night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
My eyes grow weak with sorrow. I am weak because of all my foes.
Depart from me, all you who do evil. Jehovah hears my weeping.
Jehovah hears my supplication for mercy. Jehovah receives my prayer!
All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed. They will turn back in sudden disgrace.
